alternatives_considered.approach: Recompute shares from expense_split_input on every read instead of summing stored payer/share rows.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Violates TR-4 and ADR-0011 directly: a later change to split() or the rounding rule would restate what people already owed, and the issue's Risk section names exactly this trap (one function computes shares, write path only).

alternatives_considered.approach: Compute simplification in SQL (recursive CTE) or a database view instead of a pure function.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Greedy matching needs ordering, tie-breaking and a transfer-count bound that are clearer and directly unit-testable in TypeScript; SQL would also split the money logic across two languages. Sums stay in SQL, matching stays pure (same split money.ts/split() already uses).

alternatives_considered.approach: Store a precomputed balance column per membership, updated on each expense write.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: A second source of truth that can drift from the ledger; TR-4 defines the balance AS the sum of stored rows, so caching it adds invalidation bugs for zero read gain at this scale (one grouped SUM per group).

validated_work_order.approach: Add a pure, dependency-free src/lib/balances.ts (netBalances over member id list + payer/share row arrays using bigint only; simplifyDebts as greedy largest-creditor vs largest-debtor with memberId tie-break, zero-sum throw, n-1 bound) and wire it through authorised reads in src/lib/access.ts, never touching expense_split_input on any read path. readMembers stops returning the 0n literal and attaches real balances from two grouped SUM queries (payers, shares, non-deleted expenses only); listGroupsForUser computes the caller's per-group net the same way so home totals are exact sums of per-group nets. New /groups/[id]/balances page asserts sum===0n then calls simplifyDebts; presentational BalancesScreen renders direction words visibly beside mono figures, the dominant transfer list, and the verbatim settled sentence. GroupOverview is extended (not replaced) with the same blocks. leaveGroup/removeMember enforce the non-zero guard inside their transactions via a new readNetBalanceForMember helper and surface the 'settle first' sentence; MembersScreen disables the controls with that sentence beside them. Home fetches per-group balances with Promise.allSettled so one failure withholds the totals but keeps the rest with an inline Try again row. No migration: expense_payer/expense_share/expense_split_input already exist (0003_expenses); no payment table exists yet (piece 7 owns TR-7), so balances sum expenses only. No doc edits: TR-4's rewrite and the split-input model already landed in docs/trd.md, project.md and schema comments; the reserved-path guard forbids touching them here.
assumptions: No payment table exists yet, so 'net balance' in this ticket sums expenses only; payments (piece 7, TR-7) will extend readBalancesForGroup later rather than redefine it.
PGlite/Drizzle return bigint money columns as bigint (as expenses.test.ts already relies on); no Number() conversion appears on the read path.
QA/CI fixtures use a single currency per user (EUR, as all existing integration tests do); mixed-currency home totals are an explicit risk, not a second implementation in this ticket.

'Visible without scrolling' (IAC-10) is read as: no horizontal scroll at 360px with compact one-row-per-member layout; a group with dozens of members will vertically scroll, which no layout can avoid.
The Record-payment entry point has no IAC and its write belongs to piece 7, so this ticket renders it disabled with a helper sentence rather than building a form.
readMembers' canonical order (owner first, created_at, id) is stable and is the display order for balances and transfers.
validated_work_order.confidence_rationale: Read path is new code over an already-merged expense ledger (#6) with an exact schema match; the only behavioural changes to existing flows are the leave/remove guard (additive refusal) and replacing 0n literals with sums. Main uncertainty is the home partial-failure UX shape and mixed-currency totals, both flagged rather than hidden.
validated_work_order.debate_summary: The critique (plan/critique.json) was empty — an empty object with no findings — so there was nothing to accept or rebut, and no finding that contradicted the binding decisions in plan/brief.md. I therefore judged the proposal directly against the code and the brief instead of splitting a difference that did not exist. I verified the load-bearing claims myself: src/lib/balances.ts does not exist; readMembers and listGroupsForUser return 0n literals (access.ts); leaveGroup/removeMember contain no balance check; expense_payer/expense_share/expense_split_input exist in 0003_expenses with no payment table anywhere; GroupOverview renders direction=settled zeros; and the target test file tests/components/group-screens.test.tsx exists. All checked out, so the proposal stands essentially as written. Points I weighed and kept: the per-group (not per-person) home breakdown reading of IAC-5, flagged in unknowns rather than hidden; the disabled Record-payment control, which has no IAC and whose write belongs to piece 7; and the no-horizontal-scroll reading of IAC-10. Nothing the proposal and the (absent) critique both missed was material enough to rewrite the plan around: refused leave/remove writes no activity entry, which is correct per TR-17 since a refusal is not a mutation.

validated_work_order.understanding: Issue #8 (part of epic #1, depends on #6 which has merged) builds the read-only balances piece: per-member nets + greedy simplified debts on /groups/[id]/balances, real figures on the group overview and home (owe/owed totals + breakdowns), and the balance-guarded leave/remove rules with removal that preserves history. Binding decisions from the pipeline (route note / replan-project on #1): (1) the split RULE is stored with the expense (split_type + expense_split_input, already in schema via 0003_expenses and written by createExpenseWithRows) while balances read ONLY expense_payer/expense_share; (2) TR-4 as rewritten (edit/delete replaces that expense's payer+share rows in one transaction with its activity entry; no balance changes except through a write to that expense or a payment; algorithm changes never restate history). Current code state: no src/lib/balances.ts; readMembers and listGroupsForUser return 0n literals with comments naming this piece as their replacement; GroupOverview/MembersScreen/GroupList all render direction='settled' zeros; leaveGroup/removeMember have no balance check; no payment table and no seed endpoint exist, so balances sum expenses only and QA drives flows manually.
unknowns: Whether QA's seed will include multi-expense balance fixtures by the time this is tested (no seed endpoint exists in src/app/api yet; the QA script assumes manual flows).

The exact intended 'per-person breakdown' on home (per counterparty vs per group): the plan implements per-group lines naming the group and amount, which is what IAC-6's exact-sum check is written against.
Whether the Record-payment button must be visible in this piece despite its write belonging to piece 7: no IAC pins it, so it ships disabled with a helper sentence.
